def factor_vol_regime_momentum(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    daily_ret = close.pct_change()
    ema_ret = daily_ret.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=20)
    signal = ema_ret * vol_ratio
    signal = signal.ffill().fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_vol_regime_momentum"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_vol_regime_momentum"]
description: Mutation of qualified parent to replace manual fast/slow volume ratio with the reusable classify_volume_regime tool for volume intensity modulation. The tool provides a continuous volume/EMA ratio that measures trading intensity relative to recent average, reducing noise from dual-EMA ratio and improving stability. Core momentum trending via ewm span=10 is preserved. Parent strength target: momentum with volume confirmation; bottleneck: volume ratio noise.
